abstract: BACKGROUND: Facial teratoma is a rare benign tumor that accounts for about 1.6% of all teratomas and can be diagnosed by prenatal ultrasound (US). The purpose of this report was to describe our experience with the diagnosis of fetal facial teratoma by prenatal US at second trimester to provide a reference for clinical diagnosis of fetal maxillofacial teratoma. CASE SUMMARY: We present two cases of patients with abnormal fetal facial findings on US at second trimester of pregnancy in our department. Case 1 was a 31-year-old G3 P1 + 1 female, with US revealing a heterogeneous echogenicity of 32 mm × 20 mm × 31 mm on the fetal face, most of it located outside the oral cavity and filling the root of the oral cavity. Case 2 was a 29-year-old G1P0 female, with fetal head and neck US revealing a cystic-solid echo mass measuring 42 mm × 33 mm × 44 mm, the upper edge of the lesion reaching the palate and filling the oral cavity. The contours of the lesions were visualized using three-dimensional (3D) US imaging. Both patients decided to give up treatment. Biopsies of the lesions were performed after induction of labor, and diagnosed as maxillofacial teratoma. CONCLUSION: Fetal maxillofacial teratomas can be diagnosed by US in early pregnancy, allowing parents to expedite treatment decisions.
abstract_ja: 背景：顔面奇形腫は稀な良性腫瘍で、すべての奇形腫の約1.6%を占め、出生前超音波（US）で診断できる。本報告の目的は、妊娠第2三半期の出生前USによる胎児顔面奇形腫の診断経験を記述し、胎児顔面奇形腫の臨床診断の参考となることである。症例の要約：本科で妊娠第2三半期にUS上異常な胎児顔面所見を有する患者2症例を提示する。症例1は31歳の経妊経産婦（G3 P1 + 1）で、USで胎児顔面に32 mm × 20 mm × 31 mm の不均一なエコー輝度を認め、その大部分が口腔外に位置し口腔根部を満たしていた。症例2は29歳の初妊初産婦（G1P0）で、胎児頭頸部USで42 mm × 33 mm × 44 mm の嚢胞性-固形エコー塊を認め、病変の上縁は口蓋に達し口腔を満たしていた。病変の輪郭は3次元（3D）US画像を用いて描出された。両患者は治療を放棄することを決定した。分娩誘発後に病変の生検が施行され、顔面奇形腫と診断された。結論：胎児顔面奇形腫は妊娠早期にUSで診断でき、両親は治療決定を早めることができる。
